title: Post 5 | The Yellow Hours 🚪
style_prompt: liminal empty office space, yellow wallpaper, damp beige carpet, buzzing fluorescent ceiling lights, one bright light source, well exposed, 35mm film grain, no people, no faces, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 4:44 a.m. I found the second tag on the floor.

scenes.narration: At 4:44 a.m. I found the second tag on the floor.
I had thrown it away. I was sure. I threw it down the stairs and heard it hit the bottom.
Now it lay in front of me. Dry. Clean. And next to it, wet footprints. Coming from the end of the hall. Toward me.
I followed them backwards. They led past a cart under a white sheet. It had not been there before. One wheel was still turning.
I did not lift the sheet. I walked into the next room. A table. A logbook, open. And two chairs facing each other. One of them was still warm.
I read the page. My handwriting. Tonight he finally threw it away. Now we can switch.
Behind me a door opened. Light flooded the hall. And a shadow fell across the carpet. Not mine. Standing exactly where I stood.
I looked down at my own feet. I had no shadow at all.
So tell me. Do you sit in the warm chair, or run?
